description: E15 grounding gold set. Each row is a (context, answer) pair labelled `faithful` or `unfaithful`, where the context is everything the answer was allowed to use — the case as the pipeline knew it, plus any retrieved guidance. The families are the point: `invented` unfaithfulness introduces vocabulary the context never contained and is visible to term overlap; `semantic` unfaithfulness reuses the context's own words to say something the context did not — a flipped negation, a changed number, a fact moved from one subject to another — and is invisible to it. `paraphrase` rows are faithful answers written in clinical synonyms, so the false-positive direction is measured too. Nothing here is generated by a model: the answers are hand-written so the labels cannot be argued with afterwards.
